summary: Frontend code review completed for profile timeout and messaging bugs. Registration E2E testing blocked by photo upload requirement. Code fixes verified through static analysis.

testing_limitations.impact: Cannot complete E2E registration flow via automated testing without file upload handling
testing_limitations.workaround: Manual testing required or use existing test accounts

profile_timeout_fix.fix_description: Replaced timeout-based error handling with AbortController pattern using isCancelled flag
details: Line 120: Uses isCancelled flag to track component unmount state
Line 139: Checks isCancelled before setting profile state
Line 153: Checks isCancelled before setting error state
Line 157-159: Only sets loading=false if not cancelled
Line 165-167: Cleanup function sets isCancelled=true on unmount

messaging_fix.fix_description: Added userId URL parameter support to show new conversation UI with message input
details: Line 29: Reads userId from URL search params
Lines 77-97: If targetUserId present and no existing conversation, loads target user info into newConversationTarget state
Lines 501-674: New conversation UI renders when newConversationTarget is set
Line 620-634: Message input textarea with data-testid='new-message-input'

action_items: Both bug fixes appear correctly implemented based on code review
To fully verify: Manual testing with authenticated user account required
Consider adding test accounts or seeding test data for automated E2E testing
critical_code_review_comments: Profile timeout fix correctly handles race conditions using isCancelled flag pattern - no timeout errors should occur during navigation
Messaging fix properly handles userId URL param and displays new conversation UI with message input field
Both fixes have appropriate data-testid attributes for future automated testing
seed_data_creation: None - registration blocked by photo upload requirement
context_for_next_testing_agent: Registration flow requires mandatory photo upload on Step 4 (Bio). The registration form has 4 steps: Identity, Preferences, Lifestyle, Bio. All steps have validation. To complete E2E testing, either: 1) Create a test account manually and provide credentials, 2) Modify registration to make photo optional for testing, or 3) Implement proper file upload in Playwright tests. The code fixes look correct based on static analysis.

profile_timeout_bug.root_cause: Previous implementation likely used setTimeout-based timeout which caused race conditions when navigating between pages
profile_timeout_bug.fix_applied: Replaced with AbortController pattern using isCancelled flag that properly handles component unmount and prevents state updates on unmounted components

messaging_bug.root_cause: SecureMessaging component did not handle userId URL parameter to show new conversation UI when clicking Send Message from a profile
messaging_bug.fix_applied: Added searchParams.get('userId') to read target user ID, loads target user info if no existing conversation, renders new conversation UI with message input field
